summary.text: Dylan R. Pugh, a Democrat, represents House District 114 (Portland) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Portland. The House profile lists membership on the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 132nd Legislature.
The profile gives software engineer as the occupation and a B.A. (2011) from the College of the Atlantic.
Listed affiliations include Big Brothers Big Sisters of Southern Maine.
